title: A Extraction for the Debt
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Mara Villalobos, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
